_comment: Gifts the spell catalogue's marks give for their time (a buff's "traits", rules/engine/traits.of).

expeditious_retreat.name: Expeditious Retreat
expeditious_retreat.text: Dash as a bonus action while the spell lasts.

flyby.name: Flyby
flyby.text: Flies in and out of reach without giving anyone a blow at it.

agile.name: Agile
agile.text: Slips out of reach without giving anyone a blow at it.

standing_leap.name: Standing Leap
standing_leap.text: Leaps far for its size, running start or not.

jumper.name: Jumper
jumper.text: Leaps far for its size, running start or not.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.text: Mimics the voices and sounds it has heard.

life_bond.name: Life Bond
life_bond.text: Healed by a spell of level 1 or more within 5 feet of it, its rider heals it as much.

spirit_regeneration.name: Regeneration
spirit_regeneration.text: A slaad spirit: 5 hit points back at the start of each of its turns, while it has at least 1.

whispering_aura.name: Whispering Aura
whispering_aura.text: At the start of its turns, every creature within 5 feet but its caster makes a Wisdom save against the caster's spell save DC or takes 2d6 psychic damage.

festering_aura.name: Festering Aura
festering_aura.text: Any creature but its caster that starts its turn within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or is Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

heated_body.name: Heated Body
heated_body.text: A creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 1d10 fire damage.

stony_lethargy.name: Stony Lethargy
stony_lethargy.text: A foe that starts its turn within 10 feet of it, where it can see, makes a Wisdom save or cannot make Opportunity Attacks and has half its Speed until the start of its next turn.

berserk_lashing.name: Berserk Lashing
berserk_lashing.text: Its reaction, when a creature hurts it: a Slam at that creature if it can reach it.

amorphous_form.name: Amorphous Form
amorphous_form.text: Moves through a space as narrow as an inch without squeezing.

incorporeal_passage.name: Incorporeal Passage
incorporeal_passage.text: Moves through creatures and things as if they were difficult terrain.

shared_resistances.name: Shared Resistances
shared_resistances.text: Its caster shares the resistance its breath is made of while they hold the spell.

magic_resistance.name: Magic Resistance
magic_resistance.text: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

death_throes.name: Death Throes
death_throes.text: When it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends, it explodes: everyone within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save against its caster's spell save DC, 2d10 fire and the spell's level, half on a save.

devils_sight.name: Devil's Sight
devils_sight.text: Magical darkness does not stop its darkvision.

yugoloth_step.name: Yugoloth's Step
yugoloth_step.text: After each blow of its Claws, hit or miss, it can teleport up to 30 feet to a space it can see.
